Default: 100 kb for QDNAseq.

Including normal/control samples selects the ONT solid-biopsy QDNAseq workflow.

View all study contexts and when to use them (opens in a new tab)

Uses the included evidence catalog. No publication searches or language-model downloads.

ONT methylation with Modkit

Dorado calls modified bases from POD5, or reuses MM/ML calls in your BAMs. Modkit extracts CpG methylation. Select Sturgeon for CNS tumours or MARLIN for leukemias.

Modkit and Sturgeon use CPU. GPU can accelerate POD5 basecalling and MARLIN inference. FASTQs alone do not contain methylation calls.

Or select installed tools and model files below. Blank tool fields use your command search path where supported. Models are required here or in the YAML. Setup records checksums automatically.
